description: Self-hosted sonic analysis to rediscover songs and generate intelligent playlists for Navidrome, Jellyfin, LMS, Lyrion, Emby and Plex
notes: Start the server with 'AudioMuse-AI.exe start' and stop it with 'AudioMuse-AI.exe stop'.
Once started, open the web UI at http://127.0.0.1:8000
Application data (database, temp audio) is stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\AudioMuse-AI.
Stop any running instance before running 'scoop update audiomuse-ai'.
